clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken gather in the Pools of Vision, beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. Still waters and dim caverns shelter their enclave within the tauren capital.

The Pools of Vision lie beneath Spirit Rise, below Thunder Bluff's sunlit peaks. A cave path beside the bridge to the rise leads down into the grotto. Misty waters fill its shadowed chambers, where Horde spellcasters gather apart from the open-air lodges above.

Forsaken make their base within the Pools of Vision. Undead priests practice shadowed arts, mages conjure arcane portals, and Defiler emissaries seek recruits for their campaigns in the Arathi Highlands. Whether tauren skepticism or the Forsaken's own preference for darkness brought them here, the cavern links Lordaeron's undead with their allies in Kalimdor.
